pullRequest.title: chore: build the plugins against Paseo SDK 0.9.2
pullRequest.body:
Closes #89.

- `@getpaseo/plugin` is bumped to `0.9.2` in all three plugins, and `@getpaseo/client` to `^0.9.2` in claude-tty and discord-rich-presence, matching the Paseo desktop build in use.
- The lockfile resolves `plugin`, `client`, `protocol` and `relay` to `0.9.2`, and the linked type definitions are `0.9.2`.
- The published `0.9.2` packages differ from `0.9.1` only in their `package.json`, so no plugin code or behaviour changes. The manifests keep requiring `>=0.9.0`.
- `0.9.2` was published four days ago, old enough for pnpm's minimum release age, so `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` is unchanged.

Typecheck and tests pass across the workspace.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.messageHeadline: chore: build the plugins against Paseo SDK 0.9.2
commit.messageBody:
Every plugin now pins `@getpaseo/plugin` 0.9.2, and the two that use it `@getpaseo/client` ^0.9.2, matching the Paseo desktop build in use.
The lockfile resolves plugin, client, protocol and relay to 0.9.2.
The published 0.9.2 packages differ from 0.9.1 only in their package.json, so no plugin code changes.
The manifests keep requiring Paseo >=0.9.0, since nothing needs a newer host.

commit.messageHeadline: docs(claude-tty): stop naming the SDK version in CLAUDE.md
commit.messageBody:
It went stale on every bump, while the rule it carries does not depend on the version.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.messageHeadline: test(claude-tty): stop counting the down keys an answered startup men…
commit.messageBody:
…u gets

The tests that expect the adapter to answer the workspace trust, external imports, bypass permissions or stale resume menu named exactly one down key before the confirm.
The adapter looks again 25ms after each key and presses down once more if the marker has not moved, so a runner that stalls past that look before the fake repaints sends two, which failed the workspace trust test on #105's CI.
Those tests now collapse the run of downs before the confirm and assert the rest, and the dropped-key test asserts at least two downs rather than exactly two.
Delaying the fake's repaint by 40ms reproduces the old failure every time.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

nodes.title: Bump the Paseo SDK to 0.9.2 across the workspace
nodes.body:
## What to build

Every package in the workspace pins `@getpaseo/plugin` and `@getpaseo/client` at 0.9.2, matching the Paseo desktop build in use, and the workspace is reinstalled so the installed SDK matches the pins.
Today packages pin 0.9.1 while the installed SDK is still 0.8.0, so 0.9 APIs are missing from the installed types.
0.10.0 is out of scope because it needs a host upgrade.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every package pins `@getpaseo/plugin` 0.9.2 and, where used, `@getpaseo/client` 0.9.2
- [ ] The lockfile resolves both SDK packages to 0.9.2 and the installed type definitions are 0.9.2
- [ ] Any type errors or behaviour changes the bump surfaces in existing plugins are fixed
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass at the root

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
